Message:
The voices echoing within the fog
were sad cries begging for help.

When those voices resonated
with the scar on someone’s heart,
their scar would appear
before them as an illusion.

That must be why simply
pacifying the spirits
was not enough...

As someone who once fell prey
to the darkness myself,
I know that very well...

Just pacifying the spirits’ sadness
with songs of love or hope
is not enough to heal the scars
they have on their hearts...
The only thing that can is...

“I want to be the harmony
that accompanies the
sorrows in your hearts...”

Touching wounded hearts,
and accompanying the
sorrows they hold...
That is my requiem.

“Until your grief fades,
allow me to be the harmony
accompanying your hearts...”

“Because, lost spirits...
and cursed creatures, too—
you all want to be saved...”

With each ringing note
of my voice,
their lamenting cries
began to disappear.

And with it,
the ominous presence
before me gradually
grew smaller and smaller...
“Thank you...Primavera...”

Mixed in with
the creatures’ cries
was a rain of voices...

“It was nothing...
Thank you for listening...”

I can hear no more
voices of lament.
With this, cursed creatures
should no longer appear
at this lake...

But, there are still many others
in this world seeking to be saved.
That is why...
“I shall keep singing...

To gently be the harmony
that accompanies others’ pain,
and soothe their hearts from
the darkness that plagues them...”

As that is
The Luminary of Song
I strive to become...!

I am the harmony that
accompanies wounded hearts—
the songstress of salvation...
Primavera, after all...!
